“I worshipped the fire, the moon,
and the sun, and the deities;
having gone to the river fords, I offered oblations.”
I descended here into the water.
Having undertaken many vows,
I shaved half of my head.
I spread my bed upon the ground;
I do not eat food at night.
Those who delight in adornment and decoration—
And with bathing and clothing,
I served this body,
tormented by sensual desire.
Then, having gained faith,
I went forth into the homeless life;
having seen the body as it truly is,
Sensual lust has been uprooted;
all states of existence are severed,
as are longing and aspiration.
“Completely freed from all bonds, she has attained peace of mind. ...
Thus spoke the Elder Nun Nanduttarā.
